description:
You are a DevOps engineer setting up JFrog Artifactory to authenticate users against your company's LDAP directory server. Configure a new LDAP authentication setting with the following exact parameters:

- LDAP Setting Name/Key: corporate-ldap
- LDAP URL: ldap://ldap.corp.example.com:389/dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com
- User DN Pattern: uid={0},ou=People
- Search Filter: (uid={0})
- Search Base: ou=People
- Search Sub-tree: Enabled (checked)
- Manager DN: cn=artifactory-bind,ou=ServiceAccounts,dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com
- Manager Password: LdapBind#2024!
- Auto Create Artifactory Users: Enabled (checked)
- Email Attribute: mail

Navigate to the Administration section, then Security > LDAP Settings, add a new LDAP configuration with the values above, and save it. The Artifactory instance is running at http://localhost:8082 and you are already logged in as admin.
